# healthchecksio_channels (Data Source)

The integrations of the project. The API cannot make or change an integration. Use the dashboard for that. A read-only API key cannot list integrations.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "healthchecksio_channels" "ops" {
  name = "Ops email"
}

resource "healthchecksio_check" "backup" {
  name     = "Nightly backup"
  channels = data.healthchecksio_channels.ops.ids
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `kind` (String) Give only the integrations of this kind, for example `email` or `slack`.
- `name` (String) Give only the integrations with this name.

### Read-Only

- `channels` (Attributes List) The integrations, in the order of the API. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--channels))
- `ids` (Set of String) The UUIDs of the integrations. Use it for `channels` of `healthchecksio_check`.

<a id="nestedatt--channels"></a>
### Nested Schema for `channels`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) The UUID of the integration.
- `kind` (String) The kind of the integration.
- `name` (String) The name of the integration.
